implementation.title: Postcommit workspace roving-focus local-synthetic browser receipt

validation.sourceBinding: The supplied browser report recorded the same clean commit, tree, changed-source hashes, and production-build dist snapshot before and after the run.

browserReceipt.environment: local-synthetic production-build browser with external network disabled

coverage.assertionContract: The selected focused tab rectangle stays within its own visible tablist with one CSS pixel tolerance; document overflow stays absent and page/route scroll stays unchanged while the strip is visible.

diagnostics.boundary: These zero counts describe only the eight covered local/synthetic scenarios; they do not establish a clean-console or network conclusion beyond this receipt.

limitations: This is a bounded local/synthetic production-build browser receipt, not a full role-by-route, viewport, state, interaction, or environment matrix execution.
It covers only customer and accountant workspace filter/detail strips, the End key, and the two recorded viewports; it does not certify all keyboard inputs, routes, or workspace states.
Two intended tablist-only mobile scroll changes are recorded; the receipt does not claim a global no-scroll behavior outside the visible strip contract.
No raw screenshot, trace, console log, network log, local path, local URL, or fixture payload is retained in this repository receipt.
